DuPage Machine Products a high volume, high precision metal turning machine shop, is seeking a Quality Director to maintain and enhance the organization’s Quality Assurance activities by planning, implementing and evaluating quality related resources, equipment, software, policies, programs and practices.

The successful candidate will oversee the entire company’s quality system at the strategic level and monitor the day to day quality operations by directing multiple reporting engineers, technicians and supervisors. The appropriate candidate will interact with outside customers and potential clients. This individual will monitor, support and delegate inspection activities, personnel, PPAP, rework, and ISO activities.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

* **Bachelor of Science degree in a technical field**
* **In-depth knowledge of Quality Systems, including statistics and computer skills**
* **Problem solving and team building skills**
* **Customer and supplier response and interaction skills**
* **Oral and written communications skills**
* **10 years of Quality Management experience**
* **CQM and/or CQE certifications preferred.**

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: \* Deal professionally with customers, suppliers and internal departments as required to resolve quality issues.

* Work closely with production personnel to improve productivity and quality.
* Develop, maintain, and implement the DuPage Machine Products Quality System
* Set direction of the quality program
* Develop and implement long range strategy for Quality Department
* Upgrade Quality Assurance personnel, equipment, methods and procedures
* Establish organization-wide Quality Performance Measurement and Reporting Systems
* Define Quality Policies, Procedures, Work Instructions and Forms
* Supervision of personnel in the Quality Department
* Hire, review and terminate personnel in the Quality Department
* Work with Engineering on developing Quality Standards
* Purchase Quality related equipment and outside services
* Monitor Customer Quality Requirements
* Establish relationships with our customers
* Establish relationships with our suppliers
* Establish relationships with Operations personnel
* Member of Management Team
* Member of the Material Review Board
* ISO Management Representative
* Define ISO Internal Audit Schedule
* Train Internal ISO Auditors

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* ISO 9001: 7 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
**Overview**

The Vice President of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of all quality functions, ensuring products and manufacturing processes meet customer requirements, applicable quality standards, and company expectations. This position is responsible for developing and executing the company's quality strategy, maintaining an effective quality management system, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

The VP of Quality partners with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to improve manufacturing performance, reduce quality-related costs, resolve complex quality issues, and establish a culture of accountability and operational excellence.

Direct semiconductor manufacturing experience is required. The successful candidate must have 10–15 years of progressive quality experience, including experience in semiconductor equipment manufacturing, with a demonstrated ability to lead quality initiatives and deliver measurable improvements in product quality, process performance, and customer satisfaction.

**Duties**

- Develop and implement the company's quality strategy, objectives, and improvement initiatives in alignment with business goals.

- Provide executive leadership and oversight for all Quality department functions, personnel, systems, and processes.

- Establish, implement, and maintain an effective quality management system in accordance with applicable ISO standards, customer requirements, and industry standards.

- Ensure products and manufacturing processes meet established specifications, customer expectations, and applicable quality requirements.

- Serve as a senior point of contact for customer quality concerns, escalations, audits, corrective actions, and quality performance reviews.

- Manage root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to prevent recurring quality issues.

- Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators, identify trends, and implement improvement plans to reduce defects, scrap, rework, and quality-related costs.

- Partner with Operations, Engineering, Production, and other departments to resolve manufacturing issues and improve process consistency.

- Oversee internal and external quality audits, supplier quality performance, nonconformance management, and compliance activities.

- Ensure appropriate quality resources, inspection equipment, measurement systems, work instructions, and technical documentation are available and maintained.

- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Quality organization with clear performance expectations, accountability, and development plans.

- Promote a culture of quality, teamwork, continuous improvement, and shared responsibility across the organization.

- Report quality performance, significant risks, customer concerns, and improvement initiatives to executive leadership.

- Evaluate quality risks and make sound decisions using technical analysis, available data, customer impact, and business priorities.

- Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, reduce waste, and optimize the use of company resources.

- Maintain effective communication and coordination among Quality, Manufacturing, customers, and suppliers.

- Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Knowledge and Skills

- Extensive knowledge of quality assurance, quality engineering, quality management systems, and manufacturing process controls.

- Direct knowledge and experience with semiconductor manufacturing quality requirements and production processes.

- Strong understanding of statistical process control (SPC), process capability studies, metrology, statistical analysis, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive action methodologies.

- Experience implementing quality systems, managing audits, and driving continuous improvement.

- Ability to interpret technical specifications, engineering drawings, inspection requirements, and manufacturing documentation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex issues and implement effective solutions.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and establish accountability throughout an organization.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings and quality performance to executive leadership, customers, and employees.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and quality reporting and data analysis tools.

- Ability to balance customer expectations, product quality, operational efficiency, and business objectives.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- 7–10 years of progressive quality engineering and quality leadership experience, including direct experience in semiconductor equipment manufacturing.

-Black belt or Green belt certification.

- Semiconductor manufacturing experience is mandatory. General manufacturing quality experience alone does not meet this requirement.

- Demonstrated experience leading quality functions or significant quality initiatives within a semiconductor manufacturing environment.

- Experience with manufacturing process controls, defect reduction, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement.

- Experience managing customer quality requirements, customer and supplier audits, nonconformances, and corrective action programs.

- Proven ability to lead and develop teams, establish strategic priorities, and deliver measurable improvements in product quality and customer satisfaction.

- Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.

**Responsibility for Work of Others**

Provides executive leadership and oversight for the Quality department, including Quality managers, supervisors, engineers, inspectors, and other quality personnel, as applicable. Establishes departmental objectives, assigns responsibilities, evaluates performance, and ensures adequate staffing, training, and resources to meet company and customer requirements.

**Additional Information**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as business needs require.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Job Overview**

The Plant Manager is responsible for directing and coordinating the daily operations of the chrome plating facility and develops efficiency strategies to meet plant goals while minimizing production costs. The Plant Manager is also responsible for upholding a safe work environment, adherence to policy and procedure, and maintaining optimal operational efficiency. As the Plant Manager of a chrome plating facility, you must possess working knowledge of all chrome plating operations, including but not limited to: plating line operations, tank chemistry and maintenance, chemical handling and safety procedures, wastewater treatment and environmental compliance, equipment operation (hoists, diaphragm pumps, filter press, sludge dryer), and quality control standards specific to chrome plating. The Plant Manager must understand the complete production workflow from material receipt through finishing to ensure efficient, safe, and compliant operations. While departmental specialists will handle day-to-day execution of specialized tasks, the Plant Manager must be familiar with all aspects of the operation to effectively oversee the facility, troubleshoot issues, coordinate with department managers, and make informed decisions regarding resource allocation and process improvements.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct and coordinate daily chrome plating facility operations
* Ability to lead operations in an effective manner
* Develop and implement efficiency strategies to optimize production while minimizing costs
* Create, manage, and adjust production schedules based on manufacturing needs and resource availability
* Monitor all equipment and machinery to ensure proper functioning and maintenance standards
* Oversee quality control and inspection procedures to verify that products meet specified quality standards
* Demonstrate understanding of customer-specified quality standards and rejection procedures
* Direct relations with customers & understand their needs.
* Properly handle and package finished products per customer requirements
* Accurately identify and manage customer materials throughout the production process
* Maintain all tools and equipment in proper working order; coordinate maintenance activities
* Effectively communicate departmental supply needs and resource requirements to appropriate personnel
* Oversee and collaborate with all departmental managers to ensure all aspects of operations run efficiently and effectively
* Host regular meetings with departmental managers to resolve issues and ensure efficient, balanced, and cost-effective workflow
* Keep work areas clean, organized, and compliant with safety standards
* Use proper personal protective wear and equipment; ensure all employees do the same
* Possess working knowledge of all appropriate statutes and regulations governing the facility, including environmental and safety regulations specific to chrome plating operations
* Report any unsafe or potentially hazardous conditions immediately
* Maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures

**Responsibilites / Skills**

* Comprehensive understanding of chrome plating processes and operations
* Knowledge of chrome plating chemistry, tank maintenance, and quality standards
* Understanding of equipment operation specific to chrome plating facilities (hoists, pumps, filter press, etc.)
* General mechanical awareness in operating automated equipment
* Ability to perform multi-tasked operations and manage competing priorities
* Strong communication skills—both written and verbal
* Leadership and team management capabilities
* Understanding of appropriate statutes and regulations applicable to chrome plating operations and environmental compliance
* Understanding of production process flow and efficiency optimization
* Ability to read and interpret work instructions, schedules, and technical documentation
* Problem-solving skills and attention to detail

* Vision insurance

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
With a legacy spanning over 35 years, Harris Spice has been a trusted partner and leading supplier of high-quality spices, herbs, and innovative seasoning blends. With international facilities and a global supply chain, we proudly serve multiple channels of trade—including industrial bulk, food service, and retail. Our commitment to excellence, quality and consistency has earned us the trust of some of the nation’s largest and most recognized brands. As Harris Spice continues to grow, we are dedicated to cultivating a dynamic, inclusive workplace where innovation thrives. We're looking for diverse, talented individuals who are ready to grow with us and help strengthen a brand known for trust, quality, and bold flavor solutions.

**Position Overview/Job Summary:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the manufacturing facility, overseeing Production and Maintenance, and Planning & Scheduling as assigned. This role ensures safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations while meeting production targets, customer demand, quality standards, and food safety requirements. The Plant Manager drives operational excellence, equipment reliability, continuous improvement, and cost control while developing a strong, accountable team to achieve the company's business objectives.

**Essential Job Functions:**

· Provide overall leadership and direction for plant operations to achieve production, quality, safety, service, and financial objectives.

· Oversee Production and Maintenance, and Planning & Scheduling as assigned.

· Establish departmental goals, KPIs, and performance expectations aligned with company objectives.

· Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, materials, and resources to meet operational demands.

· Monitor plant performance, address operational challenges, and drive improvements in productivity, efficiency, and capacity.

· Ensure effective coordination between departments and hold managers and supervisors accountable for results.

· Oversee production activities to ensure products are manufactured safely, on schedule, within quality standards, and at standard cost.

· Monitor production performance, labor efficiency, material usage, waste, downtime, and OEE.

· Analyze production reports and KPIs to identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase productivity, improve yields, reduce waste, and optimize manufacturing processes.

· Ensure compliance with established SOPs and operational standards.

· Oversee Maintenance to ensure equipment, facilities, and infrastructure are properly maintained and operational.

· Establish and monitor preventive and predictive maintenance programs to minimize downtime and improve equipment reliability.

· Coordinate maintenance activities with production schedules to minimize operational disruptions.

· Monitor maintenance expenses, repair costs, and equipment performance.

· Implement equipment improvements, capital projects, and cost reduction initiatives.

· Oversee production planning and scheduling to align customer demand with production capacity, labor availability, and raw material inventory.

· Ensure production schedules are achievable and effectively communicated across departments.

· Coordinate with Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Customer Service to ensure material availability and minimize scheduling disruptions.

· Monitor schedule attainment and implement improvements to production flow and planning efficiency.

· Manage plant operating expenses and departmental budgets to achieve established financial targets.

· Identify opportunities to reduce manufacturing costs, improve labor utilization, and minimize material waste.

· Monitor plant KPIs, including production output, labor efficiency, OEE, downtime, waste, quality, and maintenance costs.

· Review departmental scorecards and performance reports to identify trends, address variances, and drive operational improvements.

· Ensure facility compliance with food safety regulations, GMPs, HACCP requirements, and company quality standards.

· Partner with Quality Assurance to maintain food safety programs and ensure consistent product quality.

· Ensure employees follow established SOPs, allergen controls, and food safety procedures.

· Support internal and external audits and ensure timely resolution of findings and corrective actions.

· Promote a culture of food safety and quality throughout the facility.

· Promote a proactive safety culture through hazard identification, employee training, incident prevention, and accountability.

· Lead, develop, and coach department managers and supervisors to achieve operational goals.

· Partner with Human Resources on staffing, recruitment, employee development, and succession planning.

· Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, communication, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.

· Other duties as assigned.

· This job description describes some of the main duties, activities, and responsibilities for the role, which may change at any time with or without prior notice.

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Food Science, or related field preferred.
* 10+ years of manufacturing management experience, preferably in food manufacturing or high-speed automated operations.
* Minimum 7 years of experience managing multiple departments, managers, and/or supervisors.
* Strong knowledge of production operations, maintenance systems, equipment reliability, and plant management.
* Proven ability to improve productivity, reduce costs, manage budgets, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience with manufacturing KPIs, including OEE, labor efficiency, downtime, waste, and production yield.
* Strong understanding of food safety systems, including GMP, HACCP, BRC, or SQF, and OSHA requirements.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and ERP/MRP systems.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead teams, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability and results.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

· Ability to stand and walk throughout the facility for extended periods, including 8–10-hour shifts as operationally required.

· Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and climb ladders when necessary.

· Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to heat, noise, and food processing equipment.

· Frequent walking, standing, bending, twisting, stooping, grasping, climbing, reaching, and moving throughout the facility.

· Will be required to work around spices and meat ingredients as part of daily activities.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $155,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

* Comfortable wearing personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, gloves, and ear protection.

* Good vision and color perception for inspecting parts and identifying any defects or abnormalities.

* Hazard Communication

**Job Description**

**Ingram Content Group (ICG)**is hiring a **Sr. Manager Operations** to support our **Distribution** team in **Jackson, TN**. The Sr. Manager, Operations manages the daily operations of an assigned area within the Distribution Center and serves as a key partner to the Director, Operations. This role collaborates with the Director on hiring, safety and security, maintenance and repairs, non-product purchasing, and strategic planning to ensure customer service levels and commitments are achieved, while maintaining a zero-error environment.

Want to join a key team that helps the world read?

At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization. We ensure that our distribution centers and manufacturing facilities function at maximum efficiency. Safety is a core value in our operations environment. We emphasize this through training, education, and accident prevention programs. Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement.

The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways. If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you!

**Schedule:**

* Monday-Friday, first shift, with flexibility to work weekends, additional hours, and provide on-call support as business needs require.

**What You’ll Need:**

* College degree OR HS diploma or GED with directly related year-for-year experience
* 6 years’ experience in a high-volume distribution center OR production/manufacturing facility with a clear track record of success
* 5 years’ experience supervising at least 25 or more employees

**What You’ll Do:**

* Achieve and maintain full working knowledge of all aspects of the assigned operation
* Implement a fast-paced, lean distribution system; drive the delivery of products and orders on time.
* Oversee KPIs, goals, and objectives for the management team; set clear goals and expectations for Managers and Area Managers, measure performance, provide feedback, and hold leaders accountable.
* Build a passionate team with a positive, inclusive, results-oriented culture; mentor and develop leaders and staff; manage staff selection and development, ensuring associates are fully trained and cross-trained on systems and procedures.
* Develop, manage, and lead continuous process improvement strategies and initiatives; leverage Lean, Six Sigma, and Performance Improvement tools to enhance productivity.
* Provide strategic-level/long-term planning (3, 6, and 12 months out), including labor planning, rate forecasting, and peak season planning.
* Work closely with support functions (HR, Maintenance/Engineering, Safety, IT, and other leaders) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives.
* Ensure customer service levels exceed requirements and standards; works with management to improve cost-per-unit (CPU)/cost-per-line (CPL) while providing outstanding customer service.
* Collaborate with Senior Management in the planning, development, and launch of processes and strategies for the site; review competitive information and visit other companies to bring in new ideas on operations.
* Oversee the supervision of the operations area, ensuring the timely and accurate movement of materials into and out of the facility.
* Monitor and execute company policies and procedures for HR-related issues, including associate attendance, timekeeping, and performance reviews.
* Control and manage budget costs for all assigned departments/areas.

**Essential Physical Demands:**

* Ability to walk and stand as needed
* Ability to grip/grasp as needed
* Ability to lift/carry in full range of motion up to 60lbs as needed
* Ability to push/pull in a warehouse environment up to 70lbs force to push as needed
* Ability to bend, squat/kneel, twist/turn, climb, crawl, reach above shoulder, and type/keyboard frequently
* Ability to work a flexible which could include nights and weekends
* Ability to travel as needed
* Exposure to wide range of temperatures

*Hiring Salary Range: $113,201k - $143,945k. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary for this position. It will be determined by factors including but not limited to: the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, geographic location, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.*

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
About David AI
David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.


About our Data Operations team
Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale. This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.


About this role
As Head of Quality Assurance Operations, you'll own quality for every dataset David AI ships including but not limited to conversational, TTS, and transcription data, and manage David AI’s relationships with the global contingent workforce, comprising independent contractors and vendor-supplied contributors. You'll report to the Head of Operations and be located in the US.


In this role, you will

 - Own the quality bar across all data ops, including quality standards, calibration, consistency and on-time delivery of datasets

 - Design the quality review structure, organized by language and region, so every dataset gets consistent quality coverage

 - Audit and review the quality of delivered work product across languages, keeping quality benchmarks consistent globally

 - Run quality in languages you don't speak through deliverables from native-speaker and cross-language gold sets

 - Plan capacity against production ramps and own contingent workforce sourcing across many countries, ensuring each engagement is structured and classified correctly under local law

 - Build and own dashboards for quality, throughput, and cost efficiency

 - Manage David AI’s relationships with staffing vendors, service providers, and employer-of-record partners
 

Your background looks like

 - 7 to 10+ years in operations, including 3+ in senior leadership roles

 - You've run quality operations for large contingent workforce networks across multiple countries

 - You've owned quality at scale, across calibration, capacity planning, and spend efficiency

 - You built the system yourself, from tooling to contingent workforce sourcing at scale

 - Speech, audio, or linguistic data experience is a strong plus


VISAS

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
MicroAire Surgical Instruments LLC 
 
 As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway— you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. 
 
 
Leads Advanced Manufacturing initiatives across supply chain, sustaining engineering, manufacturing engineering, and process development for existing and new mechanical and electromechanical products. Serves as a technical advisor in researching and implementing manufacturing technology and is responsible for assigned elements of new product development under MicroAire Design Controls Procedures. Manages the technical and personnel aspects of facilities maintenance and provides technical leadership in areas critical to MicroAire’s success. 
 
 + Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

 • Drives the planning and execution of critical Advanced Manufacturing projects for insourcing, automation, and continuous improvement, including cost savings, delivery, and quality.
 • Leads or coaches critical continuous improvement, Lean, kaizen, and Blue Belt projects. Coordinates corporate CI tracking and planning, drives the site CI calendar, and tracks and reports savings.
 • Supports Supply Chain in the technical aspects of insourcing, alternative sourcing, supplier quality, and supplier continuous improvement. Supports business initiatives such as repairs and service programs.
 • Participates and makes recommendations regarding departmental quarterly plans and performs all essential duties and responsibilities within the company’s mission, vision and values.
 • Develops career paths for direct reports.
 • Provides guidance to manufacturing engineering for new highly critical products and oversees facilities maintenance activities within cross-functional teams consistent with departmental goals and objectives.
 • Oversees Engineering activity around investigation and root cause analysis for failures observed in the field that needs Engineering support.
 • Serves as the specialized technical expert resource for all project teams for manufacturing engineering projects.
 • Provides leadership by taking initiative for existing product modifications.
 • Provides guidance on Design For Manufacturing during New Product Development process.
 • Interfaces with all departments within the company as well as consultants, vendors, surgeons, and others as required to ensure quality, efficacy, and timely completion of directed projects.
 • Proactively works with team members to achieve established goals, budgets and timelines.
 • Monitors department budgets closely and takes all necessary actions to ensure budget alignment.  Identifies capital needs for production and facilities to provide CapEx recommendations.
 • Collaborates with department heads to develop and update engineering standard operating procedures.
 • Ensures project compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, especially U.S. FDA regulations and EU Medical Device Regulation supporting Regulatory group.
 • Researches and analyzes facility requirements and manufacturing capabilities / capacities around potential acquisition opportunities.
 • Provides technical training for engineering and operations personnel. Provides systems training to other functional areas as necessary.
 • Identifies Advanced Manufacturing Engineering needs and communicates these needs to Senior Management.
 • Manages facilities maintenance activities through prioritization of safety, health and production needs.
 • Identifies safety issues in the immediate work environment and other work areas and recommends solutions for improvement.
 • Ensures engineering and facilities maintenance activities are in compliance with Quality System requirements.
 • Ensures facility maintenance activities are also in compliance with OSHA and other applicable health and safety standards.
 • Performs other related duties as required.
 Authority and supervision: Directly manages Facility Maintenance and mentors junior engineers. Reviews and approves project team work and exercises sound business judgment, recognizing that errors may significantly affect the company.

 + Education and Experience 

 Education Requirements: Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering or applicable degree.
 Experience Requirements:  8-10 years of Engineering (Manufacturing & Design) experience supporting products in post market phases of product lifecycle.  3- 5 years of leadership experience.  Five years in medical device industry desirable.

 Job knowledge skills and abilities 

 • Proficiency in 2D drafting and 3D modeling, preferably AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
 • Knowledge of ANSI Y14.5 drafting standards.
 • Expertise in properties of various materials, such as stainless steel, aluminum and plastics.
 • Expertise in part fabrication techniques, such as machining and injection molding.
 • Expertise in the factors that affect the life of re-usable surgical instruments, such as corrosion, wear and thermal cycling.
 • Thorough understanding of part tolerancing and tolerance stack-up analysis.
 • Thorough understanding of mechanical stress analysis.
 • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Project and other job associated software.
 • In depth understanding of regulatory requirements for medical device design control and manufacturing.
 • In depth understanding of various surgical techniques as related to surgical instruments.
 • Ability to apply scientific reasoning and to develop test methodologies to resolve complex technical problems.

 + Competencies 

 Advanced Manufacturing and Technical Leadership 
 Skills: Automation, insourcing, manufacturing processes, design for manufacturing, mechanical analysis, and root cause investigation. 
 Behaviors: Leads manufacturing initiatives from planning through implementation; guides technical decisions and resolves complex product and process issues using evidence. 

 Program Execution and Business Acumen 
 Skills: Project planning, risk and milestone management, budget control, CapEx evaluation, and cost savings analysis. 
 Behaviors: Sets priorities, coordinates resources, anticipates risks, and delivers projects within agreed budgets and timelines; connects investment decisions to business results. 

 People Leadership and Cross Functional Collaboration 
 Skills: Coaching, delegation, career development, technical training, communication, and stakeholder alignment. 
 Behaviors: Sets clear expectations, develops direct reports and junior engineers, holds teams accountable, and aligns Operations, Supply Chain, 
 Quality, and Engineering around shared goals. 

 Continuous Improvement and Lean Execution 
 Skills: Lean tools, kaizen and Blue Belt project coaching, CI planning, savings tracking, and process improvement. 
 Behaviors: Leads and coaches improvement initiatives, maintains a prioritized CI calendar, and verifies measurable gains in cost, quality, and delivery. 

 Quality Regulatory and Safety Stewardship 
 Skills: FDA and EU MDR requirements, design controls, Quality Systems, OSHA standards, and facilities maintenance prioritization. 
 Behaviors: Embeds compliance in engineering and maintenance work, identifies and addresses safety and quality risks early, and prioritizes maintenance based on safety, health, and production needs. 

 + Work Environment, Physical Demands and Protective Equipment 

 Minimal physical demands, primary work in an office or lab environment.  May be required to do some travel, and to stand for periods of time during work or viewing surgeries.
 Works primarily in an office or manufacturing environment, with periodic work in the engineering lab and prototype machine shop. Occasional travel may be required.
 Follows protective equipment procedures for each department.  Adheres to medical facility precautions during cadaver labs and surgical procedures.  Hep B. vaccine series provided, documentation of vaccination or signed declination required.
 Confidentiality: Access to the engineering CAD database, trade secrets, and information about new products requires maintaining confidentiality.

 + Schedule, Travel Responsibility, Special Conditions or Requirements 

 Occasional travel may be required, including visits to medical facilities, cadaver labs, or surgical procedures.
 Training and certification requirements: See the individual training matrix in the Training Management System.

 Pay Range: $125,000 - $155,000
 
 
 
 
 Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law .
 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

Site: Newton-Wellesley Hospital

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

The Sr. Manager in this role will oversee the execution of MGB strategy, processes, and infrastructure for the domains of safety, risk and PFR. This role oversees a team of safety, risk, and PFR specialists to support the implementation of standardization of best practices and a system strategy. This role will collaborate with site leadership to execute long and short-term goals for Risk Management, Patient Safety programs, and Patient and Family Relations. 
 
Does this position require Patient Care? 
No 
 
Essential Functions 

* Support the build out of safety/risk/PFR infrastructure, ensuring standardization in training, processes, and safety responses that are in line with MGB.

 

* Executes the MGB safety plans including those around event analysis, safety event reporting/management/mitigation.

 

* Implement the standardized risk management strategy, policies, and procedures, ensuring that risk management activities both align to and augment our approach to patient safety.

 

* Implement the system-wide safety event reporting system.

 

* Support as needed for system wide safety events such as recalls, shortages, and other events that impact safety.

 

* Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices to identify areas of opportunity for improvement of patient safety as well as communicate to the system areas that are at risk.

 

* Execute the MGB quality and clinical compliance strategy within local site ensuring adherence to MGB standardized processes around quality measurement, strategy, prioritized areas, and performance improvement while also providing critical feedback about issues and needs that are arising within local site.

 

* Liase as needed with local site Risk/Safety/PFR leader to create prospective solutions and performance improvement as a result of safety events. Partner with safety team as needed prospectively to create performance improvement in pursuit of harm avoidance.

 

* Senior local site manager responsible for Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement QAPI planning and documentation, and updates as needed for board quality committee/patient care assessment committee.

 

* Serve as the senior local site administrative manager covering compliance activities at local site, ensuring adherence to local site standardized processes around tracer activity, site level preparedness activities, and measuring/monitoring compliance.

 

* Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices and culture to identify areas of opportunity for improvement as well as communicate to the system areas which are at risk.

 

* Provides strong bi-directional communication between the system and the site, with accountability for distribution of organization communication (including pertinent data and analytics) from MGB to local site and vice versa.

**Qualifications**

Education Bachelor's Degree Related Field of Study required or Bachelor's Degree Patient Safety Leadership required and Master's Degree Nursing preferred Can this role accept experience in lieu of a degree? No Licenses and Credentials Experience Safety, Risk Management, and patient family relations. 3-5 years required and Leading process improvement and initiatives and managing teams. 3-5 years required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities - Support the build out of safety/risk/PFR infrastructure, ensuring standardization in training, processes, and safety responses that are in line with MGB. - Executes the MGB safety plans including those around event analysis, safety event reporting/management/mitigation. - Implement the standardized risk management strategy, policies, and procedures, ensuring that risk management activities both align to and augment our approach to patient safety. - Implement the system-wide safety event reporting system. - Support as needed for system wide safety events such as recalls, shortages, and other events that impact safety. - Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices to identify areas of opportunity for improvement of patient safety as well as communicate to the system areas that are at risk.

In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. ---------------------------------------------

At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

**Quality Director**

**Brunswick Hospital Center (Inpatient Behavioral Healthcare)**

**Amityville, NY**

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director provides strategic leadership for Brunswick Hospital Center’s quality management and performance improvement program. This role is responsible for analyzing trends, identifying systems issues, and driving organization-wide improvement using data provided by the Incident Management / Clinical Risk team.

The position maintains a clear separation of duties so that special investigations and Justice Center case management remain the responsibility of the Incident Management team. The Quality Director ensures alignment with OMH, Joint Commission, CMS, and Justice Center expectations at the systems level.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Quality and Performance Improvement**

* Develop and lead the hospital’s annual Quality and Performance Improvement Plan.
* Design and oversee systems for collecting, analyzing, and reporting quality and incident trend data.
* Chair the Performance Improvement Committee and ensure follow-through on improvement projects.
* Partner with department leaders to establish measurable quality goals and monitor progress.
* Track the implementation and effectiveness of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) across the organization.
* Support organizational review of sentinel events and high-risk events through systems analysis and monitoring of resulting improvements.

**Collaboration with Incident Management**

* Receive completed investigation findings and case-specific data from the Clinical Risk / Incident Management team.
* Use this information for systems-level analysis and improvement without conducting or duplicating investigations.
* Ensure special investigations and Justice Center case management remain the responsibility of the Incident Management team.

**Compliance and Reporting**

* Prepare and submit required quality and performance improvement reports to internal leadership, the Board, and external agencies (OMH, CMS, Joint Commission) as applicable.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of quality indicators, trend data, and improvement outcomes.
* Monitor compliance with regulatory reporting timelines and documentation standards related to quality and performance improvement.
* Maintain documentation demonstrating the effectiveness of the quality program for surveys and audits.
* Coordinate the hospital’s response to quality-related findings from external reviews, ensuring corrective actions are tracked to completion.

**Survey Readiness and Regulatory Compliance**

* Coordinate survey readiness activities and maintain ongoing compliance with Joint Commission, CMS, OMH, and related standards.
* Serve as a liaison with OMH on quality and performance improvement matters (distinct from day-to-day incident reporting and Justice Center investigations).
* Oversee systems-level tracking and trending of patient complaints and grievances.

**Leadership and Communication**

* Facilitate communication of quality data and improvement initiatives to medical staff, leadership, and the Board.
* Identify and recommend resources, training, and process changes needed to sustain a culture of safety and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in nursing or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Current RN or NP licensure in New York preferred; other advanced clinical or quality credentials (e.g., CPHQ) considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of progressive quality, performance improvement, or risk management experience in a behavioral health or hospital setting.
* Demonstrated experience with Joint Commission or CMS survey readiness.
* Strong data analysis, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Experience working with OMH or Justice Center expectations at a systems/compliance level preferred.
* Prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred.

* Benefits offered. Salary commensurate with experience.

Club Car boasts a 60+ year history of industry-leading innovation and design, initially focused on golf cars and then expanding to commercial utility vehicles and personal-use transportation.

**GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION**

This newly created leadership position is responsible for building and scaling Club Car’s centralized Billing Governance and Revenue Operations function. The Senior Manager will establish the governance framework, operating model, controls, reporting, and accountability mechanisms necessary to improve invoice accuracy, reduce credits and rebills, improve cash flow performance, and create end-to-end ownership across the Order-to-Cash process. The role serves as a key partner to Commercial, Customer Care, Operations, Supply Chain, IT, Treasury, and Finance and reports to the VP, Global Corporate Controller.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Establish and lead Club Car’s centralized Billing Governance and Revenue Operations function.
* Design and document future-state Order-to-Cash processes, ownership matrices, escalation paths, and governance routines.
* Develop KPI dashboards monitoring invoice accuracy, dispute trends, credit/rebill activity, deductions, billing cycle times, DSO, and collection effectiveness.
* Create governance forums that drive accountability across Commercial, Operations, Customer Care, Supply Chain, IT, and Finance.
* Define standardized billing policies, procedures, controls, and performance expectations.
* Identify and eliminate root causes of pricing discrepancies, master data issues, shipping variances, tax errors, and order-entry defects.
* Partner with IT to automate billing workflows, reporting, and exception management processes.
* Lead enterprise-wide initiatives focused on improving billing quality, customer experience, and working capital performance.

***Credit, Rebill & Deduction Governance***

* Own reporting and root-cause analysis related to credit memos, rebills, debit memos, and customer deductions.
* Establish accountability by customer, product, process owner, and business unit.
* Lead recurring cross-functional reviews and corrective-action plans.
* Drive measurable reductions in billing-related disputes and customer claims.

***Financial Controls & Compliance***

* Support close activities for receivables, reserves, deductions, rebates, billing adjustments, and revenue-related accounts.
* Oversee reconciliation governance for key revenue-cycle balance sheet accounts.
* Maintain strong internal-control compliance across billing and receivables processes.
* Support internal and external audits and remediation efforts.

***Leadership & Function Build-Out***

* Build and develop a scalable billing governance organization as business needs evolve.
* Establish training, operating procedures, performance metrics, and management routines.
* Lead organizational change management necessary to implement new processes and controls.
* Champion analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Centralized billing governance structure implemented enterprise-wide.
* Improved first-pass invoice accuracy and reduced manual corrections.
* Reduction in credits, rebills, deductions, and customer disputes.
* Improved DSO, collection performance, and working-capital visibility.
* Sustainable cross-functional accountability for Order-to-Cash performance.

**OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintains safe and productive work environment by assuring the work area is clear of tools, brooms, debris, and other items that may present a hazard.
* Will be required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE JOB**

*Education:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.

*Experience:*

* 7+ years of finance, billing operations, revenue operations, accounts receivable, or controllership experience.
* 3+ years of leadership experience with demonstrated success driving change.
* Experience building, transforming, or standardizing business processes in complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge of O2C, billing operations, internal controls, ERP systems, and process governance.

*Preferred:*

* CPA, CMA, MBA, Lean Six Sigma, manufacturing experience, Power BI, or shared-services transformation experience.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Ability to react with appropriate levels of urgency to situations and events that require quick response or turnaround.
* Exceptional organizational, project management, time management, and attention to detail capabilities.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to deal with and manage uncertainty and change.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to complete a high volume of tasks and projects with little or no guidance.
* Demonstrates an ability to teach others how to use various systems effectively.
* Shows an ability to keep up with changing technologies and attend meetings or conferences for ongoing education.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen.
* This position may be required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to feel; reach with hand and arms, and stoop, kneel or crouch as needed.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Leads and directs process and overall quality improvement activities that produce better patient care and more efficient operations. Develops programs to review and evaluate patient care and outcomes. Implements a strategy and plans for a quality improvement function within the facility in collaboration with the administrative and clinical leaders of the hospitals that Cohesive manages. Tracks and presents results of improvement efforts and ongoing measures of clinical processes to management. Provides input to strategic decisions that affect the functional area of responsibility. May give input into developing the budget. Capable of resolving escalated issues arising from operations and requiring coordination with other.

 

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**

Minimum Qualifications:

* Ability to project a professional Image.

* Knowledge of regulatory standards and compliance requirements.

* Knowledge of techniques and methods of patient care services and instructions for patients and their families.

* Working knowledge and ability to apply professional standards of practice in job situations.

* Strong organizational and analytical skills.

* Persons who have been found guilty by a court of law of abusing, neglecting, or mistreating individuals in a health care related setting are ineligible for employment in this position.

* Freedom from illegal use of drugs.

* Ability to perform each position responsibility satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties of the position.

* Ability to understand that safety is a condition of employment. Unsafe acts or conditions will be reported to the supervisor

* Must be computer literate with ability to enter information in the EHR system and compile reports or data as requested.

* Must be able to read, write and speak English.

**POSITION DETAILS:**

* Provide leadership in ongoing development and implementation of a data-based monitoring, tracking and process improvement system that will ensure compliance with the state of OK/TN/KS requirements for quality management.

* Ensures review of clinical records regarding diagnosis, treatment and summary of member's progress. Ensures individual and systemic quality of care. Confers with other practitioners and technical experts in own field of specialization, to broaden knowledge, acquire specific information, or obtain advice or consultation.

* Implements process improvement and integrates quality throughout the organization.

* Assures regulatory compliance within assigned areas of responsibilities and in collaboration with peers. Establishes external networks to facilitate benchmarking and practice excellence. Demonstrates leadership within and outside the facility to promote a model of excellence in practice, education, and administration.

* Ensures that review of medical records for quality of care issues, compliance with best practices, and potential litigation concerns occurs as needed.

* Performs other duties as assigned.

 

**Education and/or Experience:**

* Must possess current state RN license and BLS certification.

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A./B.S.) in related health field preferred.

* One-year process improvement experience preferred.

* Demonstrated competence in reacting to and handling emergencies.

* Able to work collaboratively with multiple health professionals in a busy and complex environment using tact, diplomacy, and discipline.

* Ability to understand and adhere to established policies, procedures, and protocols.

* Strong charting/documentation skills.

* Ability to effectively communicate with people at all levels and from various backgrounds.

* Commitment to excellence and high standards

* Excellent written and oral communication skills

* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills

* Ability to manage priorities and workflow

* Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm

* Good judgement with the ability to make timely and sound decisions

* Bilingual skills a plus.

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Required:**

* Current licensure as a RN to practice in the State of Oklahoma by the State Board

* Current BLS certification

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

English is the primary language of the facility. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and policy procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of executives, managers, clients, customers, and the public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, percent as well as draw and interpret various graphs.

**REASONING ABILITY**

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instruction furnished in written, oral and/or diagram form. Ability to define and solve problems, interpret data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in statistical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each key function satisfactorily based on five overall skills categories; assessment, planning, intervention, evaluation and teaching/coaching. Each category will be assessed on performance measurements of appropriateness, efficiency, effectiveness and timeliness. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the key functions.

**Patient Rights** Promotes and protects patients’ rights; treats patients with dignity and respect; reports suspected abuse or neglect.

**Leadership** Demonstrates willingness to try new tasks; generates new ideas for change; evaluates and recognizes priorities; communicates and models organizational values; fosters high performance; recognizes need for and provides adequate resources.

**Process Improvement** Applies process improvement methods and techniques; assists in data collection; identifies processes for improvement in daily work; and assists in education of new employees in the team process.

**Environment of Care** Demonstrates understanding of fire and emergency procedures; participates in fire and disaster drills; demonstrates understanding of safety and security procedures; applies safety and security precautions; demonstrates understanding of hazardous materials plan; demonstrates proper use of equipment.

**Infection Control** Applies hand-washing principles during daily work; demonstrates understanding of isolation precautions; recognizes signs and symptoms of infection and complies with the employee health program; demonstrates understanding of the process for identifying and handling infectious waste; maintains personal hygiene; complies with OSHA standards in the work place; and demonstrates understanding of cross-contamination.

**Information Management** Enters or records data timely and accurately; protects confidentiality of patient information; protects data against loss or destruction; reports suspected violation of security/confidentiality issues.

**INTERPERSONAL SKILLS**

Demonstrates active listening techniques; gains support through effective relationships; treats others with dignity and respect; seeks feedback; establishes systems to measure effectiveness, efficiency, and service; creates and maintains reporting mechanisms.

**CONTINUING EDUCATION**

Attends in-service and education programs; attends continuing education required for maintenance of professional certification or licensure.

 

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to work inside a clean, well-lit, and well-ventilated laboratory. While performing the duties of this position, the incumbent is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk; sit; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The employee may be exposed to some hazards such as radiation, bodily fluids that may contain disease, and fumes from laboratory chemicals.

About David AI
David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.


About our Data Operations team
Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale. This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.


About this role
As Head of Quality Assurance Operations, you'll own quality for every dataset David AI ships including but not limited to conversational, TTS, and transcription data, and manage David AI’s relationships with the global contingent workforce, comprising independent contractors and vendor-supplied contributors. You'll report to the Head of Operations and be located in the US.


In this role, you will

 - Own the quality bar across all data ops, including quality standards, calibration, consistency and on-time delivery of datasets

 - Design the quality review structure, organized by language and region, so every dataset gets consistent quality coverage

 - Audit and review the quality of delivered work product across languages, keeping quality benchmarks consistent globally

 - Run quality in languages you don't speak through deliverables from native-speaker and cross-language gold sets

 - Plan capacity against production ramps and own contingent workforce sourcing across many countries, ensuring each engagement is structured and classified correctly under local law

 - Build and own dashboards for quality, throughput, and cost efficiency

 - Manage David AI’s relationships with staffing vendors, service providers, and employer-of-record partners
 

Your background looks like

 - 7 to 10+ years in operations, including 3+ in senior leadership roles

 - You've run quality operations for large contingent workforce networks across multiple countries

 - You've owned quality at scale, across calibration, capacity planning, and spend efficiency

 - You built the system yourself, from tooling to contingent workforce sourcing at scale

 - Speech, audio, or linguistic data experience is a strong plus


VISAS

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

The Director of Operation’s duties, roles and responsibilities are dynamic. The Director of Operations is responsible for optimizing operation costs, ensuring safety, financial performance, and achieving quality, specifically for our North American Rail facilities. This role supports the team, coaches, and promotes individual staff development, and acts as a company representative internally and externally, and works closely with Corporate shared services to ensure processes and procedures that are consistent with LB Foster’s principles. Other responsibilities include managing daily operations, planning how both material and human resources are to be utilized, and leading transformational change.

**Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**

* Managing the day-to-day operations of the business focusing the company on the fundamentals of sound business methodologies and continuous improvement for multiple facilities and yards, including Niles, Pueblo, Columbia City and Burnaby.

* Evaluate the performance of the organization in meeting objectives and determine where costs can be reduced, what can be improved and what should be changed.

* Work with executive leadership to establish and provide direction for short and long range organizational goals and objectives.

* Driving and continuing to build and nurture an aggressive performance-oriented culture.

* Strategically adjusts plant activities, policies, and practices to meet or exceed key performance metrics and customer satisfaction goals.

* Continue to upgrade company processes and procedures to reach supply chain synergies between the various plants, including inventory management.

* Directing operational excellence through “continuous improvement” activities in engineering, procurement, and production management, with the aim to drive additional lean manufacturing initiatives and cut production costs.

* Interacting with plant leadership, accounting, and the SVP – Rail by providing timely financial and operating reporting.

* Continuing to develop, mentor, and build a first-class team as the business expands its geographic footprint and drive a cultural shift in the company towards operational excellence.

**Experience, Education, & License Requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related required. Master’s Degree is a plus.
* 10 plus years of professional experience with demonstrated progressive levels of management experience
* 5 plus years of technical manufacturing knowledge required
* Six Sigma certification a plus

**Skills & Abilities:**

* Exemplary interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong organizational, decision making, negotiating, problem solving and interpersonal skills
* High-ethical standards demonstrated by the individual’s reputation for high integrity in business and the ability to set that tone for the entire business.
* Strong understanding of P&L.
* Can lead effectively by driving objectives and results while maintaining the “people first” culture and engaging others.
* The ability to demonstrate knowledge of Lean principles, Six-sigma and manufacturing best practices

**Competencies:**

* Timely Decision Making
* Planning
* Problem Solving
* Directs Others
* Transformational Leadership
* Manages Diversity
* Managerial Courage
* Drive for Results
* Global Business Acumen
* Developing Direct Reports
* Motivating Others
* Managing Vision and Purpose
* Innovation Management

#### **Experience**

Required

* 10 year(s): Experience with demonstrated progressive levels of management experience

#### **Education**

Preferred

* Bachelors or better in Business Administration
* Bachelors or better in Engineering

#### **Licenses & Certifications**

Preferred

* Six Sigma Cert

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
The Plant Superintendent has a primary focus on driving, guiding and influencing the support mechanisms of streamlining and coordinating the overall operational effectiveness and efficiency of the assigned operations. The Plant Superintendent focuses specifically on: overall Health & Safety and Environmental compliance; quality control; maintenance and accuracy of all material inventories; coordination of inter-yard transportation of materials; ensuring volume quotas are being met by communicating with the Commercial Group; and Continuous Improvement for the facilities, administration, and management of Production and Maintenance Superintendents and Supervisors. The Plant Superintendent reports directly to the General Manager.

This position operates within flexible parameters. The primary goal of this position is to achieve excellence in all facets of facility management. Providing the highest quality product safely, effectively and efficiently decreases accidents and errors and increases profits.

**Essential Functions:**

Environmental and Health & Safety (H&S)

* Supports overall H&S issues within the facility by working closely with the Regional Safety Engineer(s). Ensures Environmental compliance in accordance with company, federal and state policies by working closely with the Regional Environmental Superintendent.
* Provides a safe environment for all employees, customers and visitors.
* Monitors H&S programs administered by MRB H&S department.
* Following an incident or accident, instructs personnel on Corrective Action Plans in accordance with policy.
* Monitors H&S and Environmental Compliance for all assigned locations to report any deficiencies and/or issues to the Regional General Superintendent, General Superintendent, H&S Engineer(s), and/or Environmental Superintendent.

Operational Performance & Best Management Practices

* Investigates to clarify, validate, test and analyze operational data for accuracy and validity.
* Oversees operations and maintenance in all departments.
* Reviews maintenance procedures and record keeping for all production equipment.
* Forecasts monthly production with Department Superintendents, in conjunction with the Commercial group, to ensure facility goals are met.
* Ensures that negotiated production levels are met and maintained for all departments.
* Assesses the effectiveness of transportation and other sub-contractors.
* Spearheads Continuous Improvement for the facility.

Equipment & Maintenance

* Monitors equipment needs and availability for the facility

Inventory & Quality Control

* Maintains communication with facility and regional Commercial and Transportation Departments to ensure material purchase quotas are being met for the facilities and material is being transferred or shipped in a timely fashion.
* Maintains accurate material inventories in all facilities, keeping in compliance with all internal and SOX controls, in conjunction with the regional financial group.
* Monitors assigned yard inventories.
* Ensures that reports of any off grade/ off spec materials are discussed with supervisor prior to shipment in order to eliminate quality consumer complaints, avoid downgrades, and eliminate claims
* Ensures all storage of finished goods is done in compliance with internal controls already set in place.
* Implements and maintains an effective, documented Quality Control program focusing on a strong relationship with Commercial and Sales departments.
* Works with internal and customer specs for materials.

Budgeting & Forecasting

* Operates facilities within established Operating and CAPEX budgets and makes recommendations on a yearly basis for Capital Expenditures taking into account: equipment condition; environmental necessities; operational needs; ability to sustain business operations; business growth.

Administrative Management

* Identifies and spearheads any necessary training for all personnel.
* Ensures proper reporting is in place and being utilized for all production departments.
* Manages all personnel by setting up an appropriate management structure.
* Follows HR guidelines for status changes, salary changes, goal setting, annual reviews/evaluations, and payroll issues.

Special Projects

* Performs other special projects as assigned.

**Internal Control Responsibilities:**

Supports the Company’s Internal Control process which includes understanding, communicating and complying with defined internal controls as well as suggesting and making modifications to the policies, procedures and controls to better relate to the business.

Communicates upward problems in operations, noncompliance with the code of conduct, or other policy violations or illegal actions.

**Interpersonal Contacts:**

Internal contacts are by phone and in person with Metals Recycling Business personnel and various management level personnel. External contacts are by phone, e-mail and in person with potential and existing customers, other companies within the industry, and governmental agencies.

**Job Conditions:**

Workload is cyclical and can present significant time pressures when strict adherence to deadlines is critical. Workload is often reactive and cannot be anticipated or planned for. Often many extra hours are required, weekend, weekday and holidays. Exposure to physical operations at metal recycling yards; it is necessary to walk/climb in active industrial yards with uneven surfaces and to out-of-the-way areas.

Occasional exposure to inclement weather conditions and travel is required. Work pressure can be substantial during peak times, requiring considerable adaptability; disturbances of work flow, and/or irregularities in work schedule are expected and occur on an intermittent basis. Regular overtime is required. Offsite work involves meeting in person with current or potential customers, and visiting other Radius locations.

**Physical Activities Required to Perform Essential Functions:**

Ability to: sit or stand for extended periods of time, up to 6 hours per day. Position requires individual to: stand, walk, and/or otherwise move around a steel scrap yard environment. Some computer work is necessary requiring visual acuity to perform close detail work. Must have the ability to communicate in a professional manner by phone, e-mail and in person with all levels of internal personnel and business contacts.

**Qualifications:**

Minimum of 5-10 years previous experience in steel scrap yard operations, and familiarity with physical operations and personnel. College degree preferred; courses in business/operations management helpful. Project management experience or specialized knowledge a plus. This position requires possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive an automobile.

Knowledge of operations; leadership, analytical, organization, good communication, good mathematical skills; and intermediate computer competency. Ability to: apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of practical problems; deal with a large number of variables and determine a specific course of action.

**PLEASE NOTE: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.**

All U.S. applicants must be 18 years of age or older and all Canada applicants must be 16 years of age or older.

Radius Recycling participates in e-verify for all U.S. new hires.

An offer of U.S. employment by Radius Recycling or any of its subsidiaries is contingent on the satisfactory completion of a post-offer drug screen and background check.

All new hires must review and sign an Arbitration Agreement. This applies to all U.S. non-union employees.
